function witnessChannel(property, seed, path) {
  const channel = process.env.TANSTACK_DB_ORACLE_REPLAY_WITNESS;
  return channel !== void 0 && property === process.env.TANSTACK_DB_ORACLE_PROPERTY && seed === Number(process.env.TANSTACK_DB_ORACLE_SEED) && path === process.env.TANSTACK_DB_ORACLE_PATH ? channel : void 0;
}

  const witness = {
    property,
    seed: details.seed,
    path: details.runConfiguration.path,

`);
}
